headline: The sync is back, and it moved the blame: five days of nothing is the watch, not the laptop.
body:
The pipeline is alive - training.json is stamped **17 Sep 17:20**, first push since the 14th - and the fresh pull changed the diagnosis. It returned **nothing since 13 September**: no sessions, and no resting heart rate, HRV or sleep for the 14th through the 17th.

The wellness gap is the tell. RHR needs no training, only a watch that uploads, and it is there on **all 35 days from 10 August to 13 September** - rest days included - then null four nights running. That is a watch not reaching Garmin, not four missed sessions.

Today is the **30 min easy spin**, then pack and drive. The forecast file stops at 17 September, so I have no gust number - take it on the Wattbike at **135-145 bpm, cadence 85-95** rather than gamble the day before a four-hour N2.

Before you go: charge the watch and force a sync. Sunday's file is the only record you get.

The ankle - tomorrow is the shake-out, Sunday is 20 km off the bike. Last morning an answer changes anything.
